programs.desc: In July 2019, the world was shaken by a scandal regarding the sexual abuse of minors.Scholars in the fields of body language, linguistics and forensic psychology comment on the words and actions of the main defendant in the case, Jeffrey Epstein, who died in prison shortly after his arrest.Scientists also analyze the behavior of the multimillionaire's former partner, Ghislaine Maxwell, who actively participated in the trafficking of minors, and the English Prince Andrew.The aristocrat used Epstein's services, and during a television interview he categorically denied accusations of having sex with a 17-year-old French girl.The film features body language specialist Cliff Lansley, linguist Professor Dawn Archer and forensic psychologist Kerry Daynes.
